fusions.name: Unhurried Gnaw
fusions.desc: A slow bite that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: A wave rolls through a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocks them back 3 tiles. Each has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Pool Rest
fusions.desc: Raises a still pool where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slow Salve
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 6%. You also regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
